_about.description: Generation Zero machines by faction > class > type > layout, with colloquial and internal names for each machine and its weapons.
_about.source: Read from the game's own entity files (editor/entities/characters/machines/<type>/<layout>.ee) and the English text table, using the DECA-Dec-26 extractor.

fields.colloquial_name: Readable name (based on the in-game component label where there is one).
fields.internal_name: The game's own identifier: weapon/ammo entity name, attack file name, or layout entity name.
fields.in_game_component_name: The label the game shows when you tag that component.
fields.kind: ranged, melee, explosive, ability, support, support drop, bombs or defensive.
fields.slot: Weapon slot in the layout file.

_about.left_out: Companion Runner, control/test entities, friendly/event copies, eggs and corpses.
